definitions.explanation: Describing coffee, tea, or other beverages that have just been prepared.

examples.japanese: {淹|い}れ{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
{淹|い}れ{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紅茶|こうちゃ}→紅茶：02878_koucha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Freshly brewed tea has a nice aroma.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧、{淹|い}れ{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: Every morning, I start the day with freshly brewed coffee.

notes:
{淹|い}れ{立|た}て is part of a common pattern using ～⟦{立|た}て→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ to indicate something just done.

FORMS:
- ⟦{淹|い}れる→淹れる：13297_ireru⟧ (to brew) + ⟦{立|た}て→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (just done)

SIMILAR ～{立|た}て PATTERNS:
- ⟦{焼|や}き{立|た}て→焼き立て：08344_yakitate⟧: freshly baked
- ⟦{揚|あ}げ{立|た}て→揚げ立て：08482_agetate⟧: freshly fried
- ⟦{出来立|できた}て→出来立て：08343_dekitate⟧: freshly made
- ⟦{炊|た}き{立|た}て→炊き立て：15234_takitate⟧: freshly cooked (rice)

SPELLING NOTE:
- Also written as ⟦{入|い}れ→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{立|た}て→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ using a simpler kanji
- Often written in hiragana as いれたて

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {淹|い}れ{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧: freshly brewed coffee
- {淹|い}れ{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{緑茶|りょくちゃ}→緑茶：10971_ryokucha⟧: freshly made green tea
